system.bonus: If there's drinking, dancing, and general merry-making to be had, you'll be there with bells on. You're the life of the party and can always be counted on to share a good time. If you spend your downtime partying (which does not require a facility) you may choose to begin a mission with 1 level of exhaustion. If you do, you do not suffer disadvantage on any checks caused by exhaustion during the mission.
